Live FeatureServer and MapServer description states: The City of Escondido's parcel layer is derived from the San Diego County asessor's parcels. This establishes assessor/cadastral purpose and the City's layer scope; see evidence/official-feature-schema.json and evidence/official-map-schema.json.

Official description keys parcels to Assessor Parcel Number (APN), with temporary placeholder APNs for proposed parcels, and documents retired and stacked taxable parcels. Bounded safe object-ID reads confirm all three frozen sample geometries; no citywide or exact-WUP-point coverage claim.
